title: Prime Minister's Internship Scheme (PMIS)
description: A government internship scheme placing young people in real business settings. Its rules (duration, age, stipend, eligibility) have changed between rounds, so read the current rules and dates on the official portal before applying.
duration_text: Set per round; check the portal
eligibility: Set by the Ministry for each round. Check the portal.
organisation: Ministry of Corporate Affairs, Government of India
stipend: Set per round; check the portal

title: National Scholarship Portal (NSP)
description: One online gateway to scholarship schemes from central ministries and some states. Register once, see schemes you may qualify for, apply and track your application.
eligibility: Each scheme has its own conditions (course, category, family income, marks).

title: UPSC Civil Services Examination
description: The examination for the IAS, IFS, IPS and other Central Services, in two successive stages: a Preliminary screening test and a Main examination (written papers and interview). Dates and rules are announced each year in the official notice.
eligibility: Set by the Rules published by the Department of Personnel and Training and the yearly notice. Read the current notice.

title: SSC Combined Graduate Level (CGL) Examination
description: A recruitment examination for many Group B and Group C central government posts. The Commission's scheme describes computer-based tiers; Tier-I has four sections of 25 questions each (reasoning, general awareness, quantitative aptitude, English). Posts and dates change every year.
eligibility: Varies by post and year; set in each notice.
selection_process: Computer-based tiers, then further stages for some posts

title: GATE: Graduate Aptitude Test in Engineering
description: A national computer-based test used for postgraduate admission and by some institutions and public sector recruiters. The organising institute changes yearly; the score is valid for three years.
eligibility: For GATE 2026: studying in the third year or higher of an undergraduate programme, or having completed a government-approved degree. Check the current brochure.
organisation: IISc and the IITs for the National Coordination Board (Ministry of Education)
